body:
SQLB purpose and ownership. SQLB is a typed SQL library for Go packages that own tables and need applications to compose queries across package boundaries. Libraries export Table and Expr[T] values; callers supply joins, predicates and destinations. This avoids requiring a shared ORM model or a model generator. The cookbook boundary test keeps the example packages from importing one another.
